implementation_notes: Attempt 03 is a full set of new T04 source/test additions against current root; it does not depend on or patch attempt 01/02.

ClaimService never calls EffectDispatcher. It atomically writes the business claim, audit, synchronous payment request, receipt, and outbox. Only the scheduled dispatcher polls committed rows; it rejects invocation in an ambient transaction, reads ready rows in REQUIRES_NEW, sends outside the database transaction, and marks delivered/failed in separate REQUIRES_NEW transactions.

TransitionAtomicityIT adds a real PostgreSQL enclosing-transaction rollback regression: it observes the pending message inside the outer transaction, rolls back, then asserts no state/audit/receipt/outbox remains and that scheduled polling does not call the effect strategy.

Member transition options are returned from the configured engine; ClaimService no longer blanket-denies member transitions, leaving configured role enforcement to the engine while preserving claim ownership checks.
Idempotency request hashes include actor role; a same-user receipt requested under a changed role conflicts instead of returning a saved result.

The attempt 02 trace/config/validation repairs are retained, with lifecycle-specific fact-edit policy, system transitions delegated to configured edges, and terminal fact mutation detected from empty engine outgoing options.
